I've implemented the calculator in C#, and it passes all 6 example cases in `node check.mjs` after a clean rebuild.

I also ran some edge cases by hand and they all came out right:
- **Limits:** the largest positive value works, and `-9223372036854775808` prints `error`, because the spec counts any literal above the 64-bit maximum as overflow.
- **Special cases:** `(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1` gives `0`, while the same division by `-1` is an error.
- **Bad input:** multiplication overflow, `
